svg.metadata: {"id": "s040", "name": "数轴跳格步道", "cat": "数学", "tags": ["数学", "数轴", "加减法", "户外"], "desc": "公园步道上画着 0–10 的数轴（等距刻度、箭头），每个刻度有彩色跳格圆点，虚线弧表示“+2”跳跃，背景是树林与风筝。", "stand": {"ground_y": 900, "x": [200, 1720]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "sky", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "clouds", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.2, "loop": "drift", "depth": null}, {"name": "hills", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.25, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "trees", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.4, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "grass", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "benches", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "path", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.15, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "numberline", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "hops", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.9, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "kites", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.8, "loop": "bob", "depth": null}, {"name": "flowers", "enter": "grow", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}], "palette": {"sky1": "#9AD8F5", "sky2": "#FFF3DC", "sun": "#FFD36E", "hill": "#BFE3B0", "hill2": "#A2D492", "tree": "#5FAE74", "tree2": "#9AD48B", "trunk": "#8A5A3A", "grass1": "#9CD27C", "grass2": "#80C062", "path": "#F6ECDD", "path2": "#E3D3BB", "line": "#3D4B5C", "c0": "#F27C66", "c1": "#F7A541", "c2": "#F7C44E", "c3": "#8FD06F", "c4": "#5CC3A8", "c5": "#5FA8E0", "c6": "#8C8EE6", "c7": "#C285D9", "hop": "#F2556A", "bench": "#C58A55", "bench2": "#9C6537", "kite1": "#F27C66", "kite2": "#5FA8E0", "kite3": "#F7C44E", "flower": "#FF9FB0", "white": "#FFFFFF"}}
